text.answer: Riven is a Fighter/Assassin who chains physical-damage dashes with empowered basic attacks. Her build focus is AD, and her ultimate adds attack damage, reach and a ranged finisher that hurts more as health falls.
text.counterplay: Keep space from her dash-and-stun engage; disengage during her ultimate and avoid its ranged finisher when low.

text.answer: Broken Wings: Riven chains three dashing slashes that deal area physical damage and reset her basic attack timer. The final slash hits a larger area, briefly knocks enemies back and can cross terrain.
text.counterplay: Track her remaining slashes and keep clear of the final slam; stay cautious near walls.
